description: This source file defines a Swift class `GatewayHealthMonitor` responsible for monitoring the health of a gateway by periodically executing a health check asynchronously. It provides functionality to start and stop the monitoring task, handle failures, and perform timeout-aware checks.

classes.name: GatewayHealthMonitor
classes.description: A class that performs periodic health checks on a gateway, with configurable interval, timeout, and failure handling.

classes.name: GatewayHealthMonitor.Config
classes.description: A nested structure representing configuration parameters for the health monitor, including check interval, timeout, and maximum failures.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the health monitor with optional custom configuration and a sleep function.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the health check process with specified check and failure handling closures.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing health check task.

methods.name: runCheck
methods.description: Performs the health check with a specified timeout, returning true if successful, false otherwise.
